about_the_game:
Prepare to unleash your inner avian fury in Birdoo, an exhilarating indie action game that casts you as a feathered avenger. Tired of the indignities, the shooing, and being dismissed as a mere "flying rat," you embark on a relentless quest for payback against humanity.

Dive into diverse and vibrant levels, each offering a unique battleground for your revenge. Your mission is simple yet challenging: defeat as many enemies as possible before the clock runs out. Every vanquished foe contributes to your score, propelling you closer to advancing to the next stage. As you progress, accumulate points to unlock an array of powerful upgrades.

Key Features:

  • 12 Exciting Stages: Journey through a dozen varied stages, each presenting you with distinct challenges. From bustling cityscapes, tranquil hiking paths, all the way to outer space every level demands a fresh approach to your aerial assault.

  • Power-Ups for Vengeance: Discover and grab an arsenal of power-ups throughout the levels. Unleash devastating attacks, enhance your speed, or gain temporary invincibility to amplify your path of destruction.

  • Score and Enhance Abilities: Your points aren't just for bragging rights. Use them to unlock upgrades, enhancing your bird's weapon capabilities.

  • Variety of Unique Enemies: Prepare to face a diverse cast of adversaries, with unique behaviors and vulnerabilities. From the unsuspecting pedestrian to the aggressive exterminator.

  • Dominate the Leaderboards: Compete against friends on a local leaderboard to assert your aerial supremacy. With every successful stage and high score, climb the leaderboard and prove that you are the ultimate feathered menace. Show humanity, and your fellow birds, who truly is the boss.

Enough with being called a “flying rat” and shooed away! It’s payback time! Soar with grace, strike with fury, and show your enemies who the boss is. 

Become a formidable feathered avenger, an unstoppable force of nature; your vengeance will be swift and absolute!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600X or Intel I5 6600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3600 or Intel I5 10600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space

short_description: Birdoo: Feathered Fury is an indie action game were you assume the role of a bird embarking on a quest for revenge against the humans who wronged him. No longer will you tolerate being called a "flying rat" or being shooed away. It's time to exact your revenge!
